# UX Checklist: Desktop Cabinet Embedding

**Purpose**: Validate UX, accessibility, localization, and clean-room requirements quality before implementation.
**Created**: 2026-06-16
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are the desktop meetings workspace requirements defined as a first-class app destination rather than a diagnostics-only or browser-only flow? [Completeness, Spec US1, FR-001]
- [x] CHK002 Are native capture controls, active indicator, Stop, upload truth, and diagnostics explicitly required to stay outside the embedded cabinet? [Completeness, Spec US2, FR-003]
- [x] CHK003 Are bounded offline, timeout, malformed, expired-session, denied, and not-found states defined for the embedded area? [Coverage, Spec US3, FR-006]
- [x] CHK004 Are local upload-to-review requirements specified without implying a server review exists for queued, blocked, failed, or local-only items? [Completeness, Spec US4, FR-002]
- [x] CHK005 Are V8 and Krisp clean-room comparison requirements documented without permitting visual/copy/asset copying? [Completeness, Spec US5, FR-011]

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK006 Is the difference between native shell ownership and embedded web ownership unambiguous for designers and engineers? [Clarity, Spec Product Scope Boundary, FR-003/FR-004]
- [x] CHK007 Are layout and responsive expectations measurable enough to catch clipped controls, overlapping text, hidden Stop, and compact-width regressions? [Clarity, Spec FR-010, SC-002]
- [x] CHK008 Are keyboard focus and no-focus-trap requirements specific enough for embedded content next to native controls? [Clarity, Spec FR-009, SC-007]
- [x] CHK009 Are user-facing unavailable states required to be bounded and recoverable without implementation jargon? [Clarity, Spec US3, Native Shell Contract]

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK010 Are desktop and browser state/label consistency requirements aligned with feature `016` without duplicating the web cabinet natively? [Consistency, Spec FR-007, Research]
- [x] CHK011 Are future sharing, export, deletion, and retention entry points consistently excluded or future-gated across spec, plan, and route contract? [Consistency, Spec Out of scope, Route Contract]
- [x] CHK012 Does the spec avoid making embedded readiness a prerequisite for local recording controls? [Consistency, Spec US2/US3, Native Shell Contract]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [x] CHK013 Are first-load timing and local validation outcomes measurable for the embedded meetings workspace? [Measurability, Spec SC-001]
- [x] CHK014 Is visual reference evidence scoped to sanitized 2brain screenshots and written clean-room notes? [Evidence, Spec SC-006, Quickstart]
- [x] CHK015 Can reviewers objectively compare default workspace, ready detail, and unavailable states against V8/Krisp IA gates? [Measurability, Validation Contract]

## Notes

- UX checklist passes. The feature is ready for tasks if security and infra/platform checklists also pass.
